task.title: Memo
task.description: Build a memo on a familiar topic: header with h1, one main with two sections (each with h2): a list of items in ul and an order of actions in ol, a paragraph with strong, a footer with a note in small. No div, links or images.
task.starter_code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title></title>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- header: one h1 with the memo topic -->

    <!-- main: two sections, each with an h2 -->
    <!--   1) ul - what to take -->
    <!--   2) ol - order of actions + a paragraph with strong -->

    <!-- footer: a note in small -->
</body>
</html>
hints: Inside <main> there are two <section>s, each starting with <h2>.
Items go in <ul>, steps in <ol>, each point is an <li>.
Wrap the important word in <strong> and the footer note in <small>.

and double
are not used in this task.
task.solution:
How to get ready for a trip

What to take with you

  • Passport
  • Phone charger
  • A bottle of water

Order of actions

Important: buy tickets in advance.

  1. Buy tickets
  2. Pack the bag using the list
  3. Check documents in the morning

This memo was written for a practice task.

questions.question: How many <h1> per page does the course recommend?
questions.explanation: One h1 is the main topic of the page.

questions.question: Which tag suits a step-by-step recipe?
questions.explanation: The order of steps matters, so a numbered <ol> list.

questions.question: Where is a nested list placed correctly?
questions.explanation: A nested list is part of the item, so it goes inside <li>.

questions.question:
How do you show the text

on a page so the browser does not treat it as a tag?
questions.explanation: Angle brackets are replaced with the entities < and >.

questions.question: Which tags express importance or emphasis by meaning?
questions.explanation: strong is importance, em is stress emphasis. mark is highlighting, small is a side note.

questions.question: Which of these are mistakes?
questions.explanation: A skipped level confuses the outline, and there must be one main.

questions.question: What can go inside a site <header>?
options: All the main content of the page
questions.explanation: Main content goes in main, which is single and not inside header.

questions.question: Match the tag with the "room" of the page.
questions.explanation: Semantic tags name a block by its meaning.

questions.question: Match the list with an example.
questions.explanation: ul has no order, ol is in order, dl is term and description.

questions.question: Which tag wraps each item of ul and ol lists? Enter the tag name without brackets.
Which HTML entity outputs the © sign? Enter it in full.
questions.explanation: © is used in a site footer.

questions.question: Which tag marks content that makes sense on its own, apart from the page (a news item, a post)? Enter the tag name without brackets.
questions.explanation: article is a self-contained publication, section is a part of a page.
